item.title: Breakout Ventures raises $114M fund to back AI science startups
item.description: Breakout Ventures is finding growing success by backing early-stage startups in scientific fields such as biology and chemistry.

item.title: Amazon expands a program that lets customers shop from other retailers’ sites
item.description: The changes allow more merchants to participate in Amazon's Shop Direct program, which sends Amazon customers to other retailers' websites.

item.title: AI network startup Eridu emerges from stealth with hefty $200M Series A
item.description: Unlike a vibe-coded product built by a college dropout, Eridu's co-founder, Drew Perkins, has been inventing networking tech since the dawn of the internet.

item.title: Wearable startup CUDIS launches a new health ring line with an AI-fueled ‘coach’
item.description: The wearable incentivizes healthy behavior with points that can be redeemed for health products.

item.title: Gemini can now automate some multi-step tasks on Android
item.description: Gemini on Android will be able to automate tasks involving rideshare requests, or grocery or food delivery, says Google.

item.title: Amazon’s AI-powered Alexa+ gets new personality options
item.description: Users will be able to choose from Alexa styles like Brief, Chill, or Sweet, Amazon says.

item.title: Uber engineers built an AI version of their boss
item.description: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said the company’s employees have gone all in on AI, going so far as to build a chatbot of him that they use to practice their pitches.

item.title: Particle’s AI news app listens to podcasts for interesting clips so you you don’t have to
item.description: AI news app Particle can now pull in key moments from podcasts, letting readers instantly play short, relevant clips alongside related stories.

item.title: Google’s new Gemini Pro model has record benchmark scores — again
item.description: Gemini 3.1 Pro promises a Google LLM capable of handling more complex forms of work.

item.title: An AI data center boom is fueling Redwood’s energy storage business
item.description: Redwood Materials says its new energy storage business is the fastest growing unit within the company.

item.title: Microsoft says Office bug exposed customers’ confidential emails to Copilot AI
item.description: Microsoft said the bug meant that its Copilot AI chatbot was reading and summarizing paying customers' confidential emails, bypassing data-protection policies.

item.title: Designer Kate Barton teams up with IBM and Fiducia AI for an NYFW presentation
item.description: Designer Kate Barton teams up with Fiducia AI and IBM for a NYFW presentation.

item.title: Glean’s fight to own the AI layer inside every company
item.description: Enterprise AI is shifting fast from chatbots that answer questions to systems that actually do the work across an organization. item.title: Boston Dynamics CEO Robert Playter steps down after 30 years at the company
item.description: Robert Playter announcd he is leaving Boston Dynamics after 30 years at the company in various roles, including six years as CEO.

item.title: Meet Gizmo: A TikTok for interactive, vibe-coded mini apps
item.description: Gizmo's app is like a TikTok for vibe-coded mini apps... and it's a lot of fun.

item.title: After backlash, Adobe cancels Adobe Animate shutdown and puts app on ‘maintenance mode’
item.description: Adobe's announcement about discontinuing Animate was met with incredulity, disappointment, and anger. The company has changed its tune.

item.title: Ring brings its ‘Search Party’ feature for finding lost dogs to non-Ring camera owners
item.description: Ring's Search Party feature for finding lost dogs is now available across the U.S. — even if you don't own a Ring camera.

item.title: Microsoft won’t stop buying AI chips from Nvidia, AMD, even after launching its own, Nadella says
item.description: Microsoft says its own chip leapfrogs those made by other cloud providers like Amazon and Google. But it needs more.

item.title: The AI infrastructure boom shows no sign of slowing down
item.description: ASML’s record orders show chipmakers are still betting big on AI data centers.

item.title: Anthropic reportedly upped its latest raise to $20B
item.description: Anthropic looks to raise $20 billion at more than $300 billion valuation, according to reports.
